title: Detective Realizes He Can’t Cover Up Wife’s Murder
description:
Cameras caught the moment a former detective with the Maricopa County Attorney’s Office in Mesa, Arizona, admitted to a shocking crime. Forty-six-year-old John Byrd was arrested after being accused of murdering his wife in their home in July 2024. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
